title: Attempt log follow-up: release Caducus with the attempt id and remove :r<round> event ids
description:
**Problem.** PPY-a570e8 (closed) says Caducus accepts `delivery:<id>:a<N>`, but Caducus PR #21 is merged to Caducus `develop` only; Caducus's latest release is 0.3.0 and Papyrus pins `==0.3.0`. The old `:r<round>` event id is still in `announcements/channel.py:32`. Closed with one criterion unmet; filed here, not reopened.

**Change.** (1) Release Caducus with the attempt id and bump the Papyrus pin, before any work that sends on the new records. (2) Remove `:r<round>` event ids from Papyrus code. Item (2) may be done inside PPY-efd06c (X on the new records), which deletes the old path anyway; whichever is chosen is written on both tasks.

**Acceptance criteria**
- A Caducus release containing PR #21 exists and Papyrus pins it.
- No `:r<round>` event id remains in Papyrus; sends use `delivery:<id>:a<N>`.
- A scenario sends through the channel entry point and shows the attempt id reaching Caducus.

**Gherkin features needed**
- attempt-event-id.feature: 'a send uses the attempt event id'; 'a retry uses the next attempt number, never a round suffix'.

**Dependencies:** relates PPY-a570e8 and PPY-efd06c. Does not block the rating agent. Must land before any work that sends on the new records (X on the new records, PPY-efd06c).

**Report:** papyrus-track-report-1.md, section 1 (#1631 row; follow-up 4); checklist step 13.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Branch fix/PPY-ab48d4-attempt-event-ids. No Caducus release is needed: Caducus v0.3.0 (the pinned release) already treats event ids as opaque strings; PR #21 on Caducus develop only added specs (diff v0.3.0..develop is features/ and docs, a test: commit that cannot cut a release). Verified by sending delivery:<id>:a<N> through the worker into the real Caducus 0.3.0 router, delivery log and x channel (features_backend/attempt-event-id.feature). Papyrus no longer builds any :r<round> event id: the old X row shape's event id is now delivery:<announcementId>:a<N> (row field attempt replaces round). Acceptance 1 (a release containing PR #21) is withdrawn as not needed.
